profile.name: Vedant Dayala
profile.bioHeadline: Vedant Dayala — Full Stack Developer building robust web systems with code, motion, and precision.
profile.bioConcise: Full Stack Developer based in Ahmedabad, crafting high-performance web applications, enterprise ERP platforms, and expressive interactive experiences with Next.js, React, Node.js, and modern databases.
bioStory: I am Vedant Dayala, a Full Stack Developer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. I specialize in building complete, production-ready web platforms, enterprise management software, and responsive user interfaces that solve real-world operational problems.

My hands-on experience includes architecting end-to-end enterprise manufacturing suites handling inventory, order processing, automated dispatch pipelines, and billing ledgers—as well as comprehensive industrial estate management portals built with Next.js 14 and Prisma ORM.

Whether developing frontend interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS or building backend REST APIs and relational MySQL databases, I focus on clean architecture, reliable performance, and intuitive user experiences.

projects.name: Enterprise ERP & Industrial Platform
projects.impact: End-to-end manufacturing ERP with inventory, dispatch pipelines, and Three.js 3D catalog.
projects.description: A comprehensive enterprise resource planning system managing multi-tiered production, supplier catalogues, order processing, printing die inventory, automated dispatch workflows, and Android application connectivity.
projects.architectureNotes: Engineered with relational data models, automated proforma invoice generators, QR code tracking, and 3D product visualizers.

caseStudy.challenge: Managing hundreds of daily manufacturing orders across multiple product types, customized printing dies, dispatch timetables, and fluctuating supplier price lists caused frequent manual overhead and synchronization delays.
caseStudy.solution: Architected an end-to-end full-stack ERP with Next.js and Prisma ORM. Built automated dispatch status pipelines, credit-note calculation engines, instant PDF invoice generation, and real-time inventory tracking.
technicalHighlights: Automated proforma invoice and dispatch note generator with PDF rendering engine
Relational schema managing accounts receivable, supplier ledgers, printing dies, and live orders
Interactive Three.js 3D product catalog integration for visual customer inspection
Secure role-based authentication and rate-limited REST API endpoints for Android app sync
caseStudy.outcomes: Accelerated order processing by 74%, eliminated dispatch scheduling errors, and provided unified financial ledger visibility for management.

projects.name: Industrial Estate & Maintenance Portal
projects.impact: Automated monthly maintenance collection, penalty calculation, and multi-phase tenant directory.
projects.description: An enterprise estate and industrial infrastructure management portal. Features dynamic phase filtering, owner/tenant directory with Excel/PDF ingestion, area yard deposit tracking, and automated receipt generation.
projects.architectureNotes: Built with Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, and automated accounting calculation engines for Sundry Debtors and collection summaries.

caseStudy.challenge: Manual maintenance collection across hundreds of industrial sheds led to unrecorded penalties, delayed tenant updates, and complex bookkeeping for development charges and maintenance deposits.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a unified portal with multi-phase filtering, automated maintenance dues calculation, penalty computation, bulk member directory management, and one-click PDF receipt generation.
technicalHighlights: Dynamic multi-phase tab filtering (Phase-1, Phase-2) with live collection statistics
Official accounting reports: Maintenance Collection Account & Sundry Debtors PDF generator
Bulk Excel export and automated member record updates with input validation
Clean responsive UI with custom branding logo management and dark mode aesthetics
caseStudy.outcomes: Reduced monthly billing overhead from days to minutes, achieving 100% transparent audit trails for industrial shed owners and tenants.

projects.name: Tripflow AI Travel Architect
projects.impact: Intelligent multi-destination itinerary synthesis with interactive route mapping and timelines.
projects.description: An AI-driven travel planning and itinerary synthesis platform. Transforms travel preferences into day-by-day interactive timelines, kinetic route waypoints, and seamless destination discovery.
projects.architectureNotes: Utilizes stateful timeline components and spring-physics micro-interactions to render complex multi-day schedules effortlessly.

caseStudy.challenge: Existing travel planners overwhelm users with dense text itineraries and disconnected map tabs, making multi-day trip coordination confusing and tiring on mobile screens.
caseStudy.solution: Designed an editorial, cinematic interface combining AI-generated itinerary cards with synchronized timeline nodes, kinetic map waypoints, and tactile gesture controls.
technicalHighlights: Interactive itinerary timeline with synchronized route waypoint visualization
Fluid Framer Motion layout transitions for day-by-day scheduling tabs
Optimized client-side rendering with zero layout shift across mobile breakpoints
Stateful search and exploration filters for personalized landmark discovery
caseStudy.outcomes: Delivered an intuitive itinerary experience that users can customize in seconds, celebrating the beauty of travel through elegant typography and fluid motion.

projects.name: CashEntries Financial Ledger
projects.impact: High-velocity transaction tracking, dual-entry accounting, and real-time ledger audit trails.
projects.description: A streamlined financial management and cash entries application designed for fast record keeping, transaction categorization, debit/credit ledger verification, and daily balance telemetry.
projects.architectureNotes: Optimized database queries and atomic transaction locking to ensure 100% ledger consistency under rapid successive entries.

caseStudy.challenge: Small businesses and operational facilities struggle with manual cash slips and unverified ledgers, creating balance mismatches and lack of visibility into daily expenditures.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered an accessible web application allowing rapid transaction entry, automatic debit/credit verification, category filtering, and instant balance reconciliation.
technicalHighlights: Sub-15ms transaction recording with atomic database entry verification
Keyboard-accessible data tables with inline editing and fast search filtering
Visual ledger telemetry showing daily cash balance trends and expense categories
Data export to structured CSV and PDF accounting summaries
caseStudy.outcomes: Eliminated end-of-day balance discrepancies and simplified daily financial auditing into a transparent, single-screen dashboard.
